judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S.B. 1, the Advance Ohio Higher Education Act, which banned diversity, equity, and inclusion offices and training at Ohio's public universities, barred full-time faculty strikes, and added post-tenure reviews for professors. It passed the Ohio House 59-34 and was signed into law.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing S.B. 1, the Advance Ohio Higher Education Act, which banned diversity, equity, and inclusion offices and training at Ohio's public universities, barred full-time faculty strikes, and added post-tenure reviews for professors. It passed the Ohio House 59-34 and was signed into law.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to concur in House amendments to S.B. 1, the Advance Ohio Higher Education Act, sending to the Governor a law that banned diversity, equity, and inclusion offices and training at Ohio's public universities and barred full-time faculty strikes. It passed the Ohio Senate 20-11 and was signed into law.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against concurring in House amendments to S.B. 1, the Advance Ohio Higher Education Act, which sent to the Governor a law that banned diversity, equity, and inclusion offices and training at Ohio's public universities and barred full-time faculty strikes. It passed the Ohio Senate 20-11 and was signed into law.
